detail.longDescription: What's the best, ideally most ethical, local-run # ai for # coding ? Something I can try out in Docker and maybe integrate with VS Codium? I still very much do not like # genAI but I'm willing to at least poke around, as I'd like my coding skills to not totally rust away. Also, what's a good language to pick up these days? Used to be full-stack web dev with PHP. Not a huge fan of PHP, but it worked, and I like web dev; anyone can run your stuff. # programming # ethicalai # localai
